# Cargo quickstart: first 25 leads in two minutes

Curated by Skill Harbor — @getcargohq's first-run demo contract for Cargo (their GTM lead platform): after exactly one question ("Who do you sell to?"), the agent runs a two-minute fast path — translate the persona into a `salesNavigator.searchLeads` filter (quote the title phrase), execute 25 records (~0.5 credits, said out loud before the first paid call: "this costs about half a credit of your 100 free ones"), show a name/title/company/recently-hired table leading with recently-hired rows, close with a mandatory cost receipt (credits spent + balance remaining), then offer to save the exact search as a weekly recurring play so new matches land without asking. Includes hard speed rules (no discovery detours, one command block per step, paid work capped at ~1 credit, never dead-end), a fallback ladder (theirStack job postings as "companies hiring your persona right now", waterfall prospects capped at 5 records with explicit consent since it exceeds the cap, or the free connection-listing path), and routes real follow-up work (enrichment, email finding) to the cargo-gtm skill. Honest caveats: requires the @cargo-ai/cli (npm) and a Cargo account (`cargo-ai login --email`, emailed code — no card needed to start); a new account starts with 100 free credits; listed here with credit to its creator; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
